short_description: DORZOFON-T Eye Drop is a combination medication containing two active components. It is prescribed for the treatment of both glaucoma and ocular hypertension. This eye drop should be administered exclusively in the affected eye, adhering to the dosage and duration recommended by your doctor. Before usage, carefully review the label for precise instructions. Ensure you have thoroughly washed your hands. It is crucial to use the medication in the exact prescribed dose, avoiding both excessive and insufficient amounts. Adhere to your doctor’s guidance or the label instructions meticulously.
description: Glaucoma, an eye disease, can inflict harm upon the crucial optic nerve, vital for maintaining proper vision. This harm is frequently the result of elevated pressure within the eye. DORZOFON-T Eye Drop is employed to mitigate both swelling and intraocular pressure, thereby aiding in averting glaucoma-related complications like vision loss and enhancing overall visual acuity. This medication can be utilized either independently or in conjunction with other eye drops. It’s essential to note that glaucoma is not preventable; however, its early detection is possible through regular checkups and frequent monitoring.
